stage_object: primitive canonical cuboids with exactly one integral face diagonal, with no space-diagonal integrality requirement
source_population: positive primitive canonical edge triples 0<a<b<c with gcd(a,b,c)=1 and R=sqrt(a^2+b^2+c^2)<=B
target_population: the source population for which exactly one of a^2+b^2, a^2+c^2, b^2+c^2 is a square
common_population_contract: primitive canonical positive edge triples; scale copies removed by gcd=1; permutation copies removed by 0<a<b<c; exact face multiplicity retained; common geometric cutoff R<=B; no requirement that R be integral

stage16_contract.comparison_adapter: On any subpopulation with integral space diagonal d, R=d exactly, so R<=B agrees with d<=B. This is the intended Stage16/17 and Stage21 comparison interface.

main_contract.safe_batching: May advance through multiple checkpoints only when later work does not depend on an unaudited novel claim or population-contract choice.
main_contract.current_stop_reason: Stage16-30 passed fresh audit. Stage16-40 submits the upper-bound ledger extracted from that audited theorem and stops for fresh audit before checkpoint 50.
future_reuse_candidates: AR-039 mod-7 two-parameter exactly-one family for the later lower-bound ledger after cutoff/population compatibility is checked

required_checks: exactly-one exclusion of exactly-two and exactly-three populations
R<=B cutoff and integral-space-diagonal R=d adapter
compatibility with the Stage16-28 roadmap and future Stage17/21 comparison
notation does not collide with incompatible historical populations
Stage16-30 upper-bound face parametrization completeness and multiplicity
Stage16-30 lower-bound injectivity, primitivity, exact-one deletion, and summed error uniformity
same-measure U(B) ambient asymptotic and thinning ratio
finite Stage16-20 data is diagnostic only
Stage16-40 upper-bound ledger matches the audited Stage16-30 theorem without cross-promotion

last_submission.codex_reason: Repository write recovery and ledger publication only; the mathematical upper bound was already fresh-audited.

merge_rule: The Stage16 main lane cannot approve its own substantive mathematical submission. Merge only after the required fresh Stage16-audit returns PASS and repository validation is satisfactory.
